title: The wild south
text: Cliffs, black rock and the open ocean. Stop at Gris Gris, where there's no reef and the waves hit the coast.

title: Chamarel and the gorges
route: Le Morne · Chamarel · Black River Gorges
text: Switchbacks up from the coast to the Seven Coloured Earth and the gorges viewpoint. The best road on the island.

title: The north and its lagoons
route: Port Louis · Grand Baie · Cap Malheureux
text: Calm lagoons, the red-roofed church at Cap Malheureux and sunset over the islands.

title: East coast beaches
route: Mahébourg · Belle Mare · Trou d'Eau Douce
text: Long white beaches, filao trees and the boats to Île aux Cerfs.

title: Port Louis and the west
route: Port Louis · Flic en Flac · Tamarin
text: The capital's market in the morning, then the west coast for the sunset.
